nom: OSEA Ocean Wave Cleanser Bi-Phase Cleansing Oil and Makeup Remover

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report effective makeup and sunscreen removal but frequently describe an oily film or residue after rinsing, sometimes requiring a follow-up cleanser.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the cleanser leaves their face soft and hydrated without stripping, with several noting reduced flaking and scaly patches over time.
segments.combination: Combination and congestion-prone skin reviewers are more cautious, noting oil-based formulas can feel risky for breakout-prone areas even when marketed as non-comedogenic.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly describe it as gentle and non-irritating with no added redness, though one notes stinging on peeling or broken-out skin.
segments.normal: Fair or non-problematic skin reviewers describe easy, gentle eye makeup removal without the stinging they experienced from previous removers.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (late 50s to 70s) frequently report softer, more hydrated, less crepey-feeling skin with continued use.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother, less crepey, more hydrated-looking skin and fading age spots with continued use; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most dry or dehydration-prone reviewers report improved hydration and less flaking or scaly patches, though one oily-skin reviewer found it left an oil-slick feel rather than hydration.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with a redness tendency reports no increase in redness after use, and sensitive-skin reviewers echo a calming effect; no negative reports on redness were found.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as non-stripping and skin-softening, framing it as protective for compromised or dry, flaking skin, with no barrier-damage complaints.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her chronic chin whiteheads cleared after two weeks of use, while another oily-skin reviewer suspects the product triggered new cystic acne on the chin.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or adult-acne skin report no new breakouts and a calmer, clearer complexion; at least two others report breakouts or suspected purging, and one found it stung on active breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers most often report the product leaves a lingering oily film that is hard to rinse and needs double cleansing, though one oily-skin reviewer found it worked well without breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Oily residue hard to rinse off
Fails to fully remove eye makeup
Bottle separates and hard to dispense

extraits.texte: I have oily skin and found this product to be excellent for removing makeup, sunscreen, and cleansing. However, I can't tell if this product gives me a rash, and/or if this is also causing cystic acne on my chin? I'm going to give it a few more weeks of use to see if my skin is purging or if my skin just doesn't agree with this product. I'm also not the biggest fan of the packaging because it's tough to close the bottle with a hand full of oil.

I use a different oil cleanser and it works well to remove make up but doesnt make me break out. It feels like nothing. I dont like this one as much. It stings where I have peeling skin or breakouts. And it doesnt wipe off makeup easily like my other cleansing oil. This is a rare miss for Osea for me.

This is everything. I recently discovered my acne prone skin hates being washed with traditional facial cleansers. This is gentle, washes away all the makeup, and does NOT break me out. Thank you Osea.

extraits.titre: The BEST thing to combat dry skin
extraits.texte: Ive tried many things in the winter months to keep my skin hydrated but this cleaner couple with the advanced atmosphere protection cream has been a game changer! Its light and even though it has moisturizing oils it doesnt leave your skin oily at all! Just cleans it really well! Takes off all the dirt or makeup my cleanser left behind. Then I put on the protection cream and my face has been so hydrated this winter! No more flaking or breakouts! I love this stuff!!!

I've tried other organic cleansers that are advertised as non-drying. But as a 57-year-old post-menopausal woman, I've been finding it increasingly difficult to find cleansers that actually clean my face as well as keep it moisturized. I came back to the Osea's Ocean Wave Cleanser because it's the only one that does what I need. And my face is finally clearing up from all the dry, scaly patches that began to form around my cheeks and mouth area.
Especially for dry skin. I've been using it for about a month, and my skin is much brighter. Age spots have faded considerably, too. While I don't wear any makeup, I still love this cleanser.

I bought the travel size to use for a trip for the first time. Although it removed my makeup and sunscreen effectively, it was so hard to rinse off, and I was left feeling like an oil slick, even after rinsing multiple times. Even my hands felt oily. I'm left with no choice but to double cleanse with my regular gel cleanser. This is the same with the oil cleanser from Beekman. This does not happen with my regular oil cleanser from Origins, which I recommend.
